blocks.text: Carbon atom ka environment un atoms ki qism se tay hota hai jo seedhe us se jure hon. Jo carbon atoms aik hi environment mein hon woh chemically equivalent (barabar) hain aur un ki chemical shift aik hoti hai. Misal: ethane ke dono carbon atoms ka environment aik hai. Different environments wale carbon atoms chemically non-equivalent hain aur ¹³C NMR spectra mein alag alag positions (chemical shifts) par aate hain. Misal: 2-methylpropane ke teenon methyl carbon atoms ka environment aik hai, jab ke tertiary (teen carbons se jura) carbon ka environment in teenon se alag hai.

blocks.text: Teen blue CH₃ carbons aik jaise environment mein hain, pink CH carbon ka environment alag hai. Is liye 2-methylpropane ka ¹³C spectrum do peaks dikhata hai.
Carbon atoms ke gird atoms ya bonds dekh kar environment ki qism predict ki ja sakti hai. Carbon ke different environments ki chemical shifts Table 30.3 mein di gayi hain.
